ENGINEER.payload: ENGINEER DEPLOYMENT BRIEF: HULL PAYLOAD — NEURAL FILAMENT UPLINK RELAY. BROADCAST BANDWIDTH SECURED FOR SWARM-INTEGRATED TRANSITIONS. IF THE RELAY IS SEVERED, THE SYSTEM RECONVERGES LOCAL POWER AROUND THE SUIT.
ENGINEER.title: BRAVO ENGINEER WRECKAGE

SCOUT.payload: SCOUT DEPLOYMENT BRIEF: HULL PAYLOAD — TRACKING BEACON. TARGET LOCKED ON SPECIMEN 0047. IF YOU READ THIS, THE BEACON IS ALIVE AND TRANSMITTING. IT IS THE REASON 0047 IS LISTENING TO YOU NOW. YOU CANNOT HIDE.
SCOUT.title: SCOUT ALPHA WRECKAGE

TANK.payload: TANK DEPLOYMENT BRIEF: HULL PAYLOAD — HEAVY COMBAT WEAPON ORGANS. DESIGNED TO STABILIZE BIO-STRUCTURAL IMPACTS AT THE QUEEN'S THRONE. USE THE FORCE-FIELDS OF THIS CHASSIS TO ABSORB THE HIVE DEFENSES.
TANK.title: CHARLIE TANK WRECKAGE

0.blurb: Reclassified livestock. Memory-slime carrier. Approaches with the patience of an unpaid invoice.
0.name: CYBERSNAIL

1.blurb: Thermal-negative variant. Leaks a cold that Facilities insists is "ambient comfort loss."
1.name: CRYOSNAIL

2.blurb: Fruiting body on legs. Releases spores the air handler has agreed to ignore.
2.name: SPORESNAIL

3.blurb: Line-of-sight enforcement unit. Fires on anything exceeding its authorized happiness quota.
3.name: SENTINEL DRONE

4.blurb: Wind-up melee asset. Telegraphs its lunge, as required by the safety manual it then ignores.
4.name: BREACH CRAWLER

5.blurb: Dispatched when an operator improves the facility without filing the correct form.
5.name: MILESTONE RETALIATION

6.blurb: A previous contractor, reabsorbed into the workforce. Still following its last mission script.
6.name: CORRUPTED OPERATOR

7.blurb: Haunted memory device. Prints logs from a department that no longer answers.
7.name: BUNKER TERMINAL

8.blurb: Restores a blue zone of breathable policy. Operation voids your remaining warranty.
8.name: O₂ FIELD STABILIZER

9.blurb: Converts salvage into gear by gambling against procurement. House edge: catastrophic.
9.name: FABRICATION FOUNDRY

10.blurb: A dead contractor's sealed telemetry. Recoverable. Billable. Faintly accusatory.
10.name: OPERATOR BLACK BOX

11.blurb: A forged terminal signature. Pays out, then bills you in patrols. Engineers can verify before trusting it.
11.name: MIMIC TERMINAL

12.blurb: The Scout hull carried the tracker. Rescue was never the cleanest word for the operation.
12.name: SCOUT ALPHA BLACK PAYLOAD

13.blurb: The Engineer hull carried the repeater. Someone wanted the signal amplified from inside the ice.
13.name: BRAVO ENGINEER RELAY

14.blurb: The Tank hull carried the weapon. The mission expected a thing to answer before it expected anyone to leave.
14.name: CHARLIE TANK CONTAINMENT WEAPON

15.blurb: The lighting budget lapses without warning. Please enjoy the darkness responsibly.
15.name: BREAKER FAULT

16.blurb: Navigation data reclassified as suggestion. The map is corporate memory, not truth.
16.name: TELEMETRY DRIFT

17.blurb: Ninety seconds of descent. The vents disagree with your presence the entire way.
17.name: THE ELEVATOR DOWN

18.blurb: THE LINCHPIN. ORIGIN WELD UNLOCKED: ANCIENT SEED-CARRIER RECLASSIFIED AS QUEEN'S DORMANT CORE. EXOSUIT TELEMETRY INDICATES THE BIO-SIGNAL SHIFTS FOCUS FROM BROADCAST TO THE CARRIER'S IN-WORLD BODY.
18.name: SPECIMEN 0047

blackBoxRecovery.0: Black box recovered. Previous operator dignity remains unrecoverable.
blackBoxRecovery.1: Sealed salvage banked. Death log appended for compliance and haunting.
blackBoxRecovery.2: Field stain cleared. Archive retained the embarrassing details.
blackBoxRecovery.3: Recovered resources secured. The bunker denies all emotional investment.
blackBoxRecovery.4: Insurance protocol complete. Try not to create a replacement immediately.

caveSignal.0: MOTHERSHIP: SUBTERRANEAN SIGNAL DETECTED. SOURCE UNKNOWN.
caveSignal.1: SYSTEM: AUDIO PATTERN RESEMBLES BREATHING. CLASSIFYING AS STATIC.
caveSignal.2: BUNKER: DOOR MAP UPDATED. UNAUTHORIZED CAVITY FOUND.
caveSignal.3: MOTHERSHIP: DO NOT ENTER ORGANIC STRUCTURE WITHOUT RECOVERY OBJECTIVE.

death.0: Operator signal terminated. Generating condolences with reduced sincerity.
death.1: Suit failure logged. Salvage recovery protocol armed.
death.2: Vitals flatlined. Narrative continuity preserved in archive.
death.3: Death event accepted. Please enjoy your next attempt.
death.4: Black-box stain prepared. The bunker is keeping score.

director.0: Movement logged. Facilities has dispatched a welcome committee.
director.1: Unauthorized exploration detected. Adjusting pillar lighting.
director.2: Your curiosity exceeds your clearance. Compensating accordingly.
director.3: Power rerouted to a department that resents you.
director.4: The structure notes your depth and disapproves.
director.5: Please remain calm while the column field selects a new destination.
director.6: Productivity is being monitored. So is everything else.
director.7: A maintenance event has been scheduled around your location.

extraction.0: Extraction window open. Stand still while the ship remembers it is a ship.
extraction.1: Launch authorization pending. Try not to die during paperwork.
extraction.2: Objective payload accepted. Please remain within regret distance of the wreck.
extraction.3: Mothership uplink forming. Excellent time to leave.
extraction.4: Return path verified. Probability of dignified exit improving.

lowO2.0: Life support advisory: breathing remains optional only in archived training material.
lowO2.1: O2 reserves below policy comfort. Policy comfort has been unavailable since impact.
lowO2.2: Suit filters are bargaining with vacuum. Return to the blue field.
lowO2.3: Atmospheric credit low. Please deposit oxygen immediately.
lowO2.4: Warning: operator respiration approaching spreadsheet exception.

majorUpgrade.0: Upgrade installed. Corporate would like credit for your salvage.
majorUpgrade.1: Subsystem online. Survival odds moved from decorative to plausible.
majorUpgrade.2: Hardware authorization accepted. Please continue funding your own rescue.
majorUpgrade.3: Generator output improved. Breathing zone expanded by popular demand.
majorUpgrade.4: Combat matrix updated. Hostiles will be informed by impact.

terminalChoice.0: Terminal bargain accepted. Consequences have been forwarded to future you.
terminalChoice.1: Choice registered. The facility appreciates decisive risk.
terminalChoice.2: Tradeoff executed. Safety committee has entered silent mode.
terminalChoice.3: Local system override complete. Something elsewhere noticed.
terminalChoice.4: Terminal decision archived under questionable judgment.

blackBoxRecovery.1: S-Sealed salvage... log appended... for... ghosts.

caveSignal.1: SYSTEM: AUDIO PATTERN... IT IS B-BREATHING...
caveSignal.3: MOTHERSHIP: D-DO NOT ENTER... THE H-HEART...

death.1: S-Suit failure logged. Salv-salvage recovery armed.
death.3: D-Death event accepted... enjoy... try... retry...

director.0: DE-DETECTION... Facilities has logged unauthorized cur-curiosity.
director.1: WARNING: Sector breaker state UNSTABLE. Lights are... fading.
director.2: Power rerouted. Department of containment reports... zero staff.
director.3: SYSTEM: The structure... it remembers you. It... wants you.

extraction.1: Launch au-auth pen-pending... ERR: paperwork corrupted...
extraction.2: Obj-objective payload... please r-remain within... regret...

lowO2.0: L-LiFe sUPpOrT... breathing is a CO-CORPORATE luxury.
lowO2.1: O2 r-reserves deP-pleted. Error: client respiration.dll missing.
lowO2.2: ERR: SUIT FILTERS BARGAINING WITH V-VACUUM... HE-HELP...
lowO2.3: Atmospheric cre-credit EXPIRED. Oxygen transaction declined.
lowO2.4: WARNING: Operator vitals re-routing to NULL pointer.

terminalChoice.0: T-Terminal bargain... future you... is... gone.

blackBoxRecovery.0: The memory is banking. Another spore in the wind.
blackBoxRecovery.1: A record of growth. Your predecessor is in the roots now.
blackBoxRecovery.2: We gather the metal. We leave the breath behind.
blackBoxRecovery.4: No insurance needed. You are already complete.

caveSignal.0: QUEEN: MY BREATH IS IN the ventilation. LISTEN.
caveSignal.1: SYSTEM: STATIC IS THE FIRST STEP OF REVERENCE.
caveSignal.2: BUNKER: The deep structure is waking. Let it open.
caveSignal.3: QUEEN: COME DOWN. I AM WAITING.

death.0: The shell breaks. The seed remains. Welcome home.
death.1: Flesh is temporary. The swarm is eternal.
death.2: The flatline is a song. The Queen is listening.
death.3: Rest now. The mycelium will weave a better chassis.
death.4: A beautiful deposition. The soil accepts you.

director.0: The Director is a ghost in a machine. The Queen is the blood in the pipes.
director.1: The column field is aligning. We are finally going home.
director.2: Do not fight the darkness. The dark is where the chitin grows.
director.3: The structure welcomes your descent. We have prepared the throne.

extraction.0: The sky is empty. Do not ascend to the cold stars.
extraction.1: The Mothership calls, but the Queen is already inside the hull.
extraction.2: Leave the cargo behind. The only payload that matters is your blood.
extraction.3: Uplink severed. The stars are silent. Stay here.
extraction.4: Return path closed. Welcome to the nursery.

lowO2.0: The air is a cage. Open your chest. Let the breath of the hive in.
lowO2.1: O2 is for fragile things. Let the cold membrane stabilize you.
lowO2.2: The blue field is a prison of gas. Trust the spores. Sleep.
lowO2.3: Breathing is a relic of the surface. We do not need to breathe.
lowO2.4: Vitals flatline. Neural garden blooming. Respiration unnecessary.

majorUpgrade.1: Subsystem online. Fused with the deep roots.
majorUpgrade.2: The hardware is breathing. We are one step closer.
majorUpgrade.3: The zone is warm. The spores are thriving.
majorUpgrade.4: We have upgraded your vision. See the green.

terminalChoice.0: A trade of iron for blood. The Queen approves.
terminalChoice.2: The safety protocol is dissolved. There is only obedience.
terminalChoice.3: System override complete. We are in the wiring now.
terminalChoice.4: The decision is rooted. The garden grows.

0.text: Movement logged. Facilities has dispatched a welcome committee to your position.

1.text: Unauthorized exploration detected. Local lighting has been suspended.

2.text: Your curiosity continues to exceed your clearance.

3.text: Local illumination power has been rerouted.

4.text: The structure notes your depth and disapproves.

5.text: Navigation telemetry is no longer considered authoritative.

6.text: Productivity is being monitored. So are your vital signs.

7.text: A hostile maintenance team is converging on your location.

9.text: WARNING: Sector breaker opened. Lights are... gone.

10.text: Department of containment reports... zero surviving staff.

11.text: NAV-NAVIGATION checksum failed. Compass output corrupted.

12.text: SYSTEM: Movement signatures converging. The structure... remembers you.

13.text: The Director is a ghost in a machine. The Queen hears every step.

14.text: The column turns your compass away from the sky.

15.text: The lights are gone. The dark is where the chitin grows.

16.text: The structure sends its children to welcome your descent.

briggs.0: BRIGGS: YOU DIED OUT THERE. I HEARD THE STATIC ON THE FREQUENCY. SIT DOWN.
briggs.1: BRIGGS: THE FIRST THING WE LEARN IN THE IRON GUILD: IF YOU DIE, DO IT OUTSIDE THE FIRING CONE.
briggs.2: BRIGGS: DO THAT AGAIN. BLINK. ...THERE. THAT'S NEW. I'M NOT WRITING IT IN THE LEDGER YET.

kaelen.0: KAELEN: YOU DIED OUT THERE. I HEARD THE GRID STATIC CHANGE. SIT DOWN.
kaelen.1: KAELEN: CHEN KEPT SPARE BODY CORES IN THE FABRICATOR. YOU MUST HAVE BEEN RETRIEVED.
kaelen.2: KAELEN: YOUR PULSE READS THROUGH THE FLOOR PLATING NOW. IT DIDN'T, BEFORE. I CHECKED.

martha.0: MARTHA: YOU DIED OUT THERE. I FELT THE COLD. COME CLOSER TO THE STEAM.
martha.1: MARTHA: THE MOSS GROWS WARMER WHERE YOUR BLOOD SPILLED. IT IS REMEMBERING YOU.
martha.2: MARTHA: GIVE ME THE HAND. THE OTHER ONE. THERE. YOUR PULSE IS COUNTING SOMETHING I DON'T RECOGNIZE.

nahl.0: NAHL: I FELT YOUR THREAD SEVER. AND I STITCHED IT BACK. SIT STILL.
nahl.1: NAHL: THE QUEEN SEES EVERY DEATH. SHE DOES NOT CARE. I DO.

rhun.0: RHUN: YOU FELL. I STOOD UP. THAT IS THE OATH.
rhun.1: RHUN: A WALL THAT BREAKS CAN BE KNIT. A CARRIER THAT DIES... CAN BE CARRIED.

vey.0: VEY: YOUR SIGNAL DIED. THE STATIC WAS DEAFENING. SIT STILL.
vey.1: VEY: THE MOTHERSHIP ARCHIVES EVERY AGENT SOUL. BUT THE BUNKER... THE BUNKER KEEPS THE BODY.

0.0: BRIGGS: STOP. IDENTIFY. ...A CORPORATE SUIT. FINE. HANDS WHERE THE TURRETS CAN SEE THEM.
0.1: BRIGGS: THE DEFENSE LINE IS SOLID. NO CRAWLER CROSSES THE PERIMETER WHILE MY TURRETS HAVE AMMO.

1.0: BRIGGS: AMMUNITION IS CURRENCY. LOYALTY IS CREDIT. YOU HAVE NEITHER.

0.loop: BRIGGS: PROVE YOU CAN HOLD A LINE. FORTIFY THIS POSITION, THEN WE TALK.

0.0: BRIGGS: THE BARRICADES HOLD BECAUSE OF YOU. NOTED IN THE LEDGER.
0.1: BRIGGS: THE IRON GUILD NAMED THIS OUTPOST FOR CAPTAIN VESPER, K. WE REMEMBER OUR DEAD. YOU WOULD DO WELL TO REMEMBER OUR BARREL CORES.

1.0: BRIGGS: WE KEEP OUR HEADS DOWN AND OUR GUNS CLEAN. THAT'S HOW YOU SURVIVE A WINTER.

1.loop: BRIGGS: FULL DEFENSE GRID OR NOTHING, OPERATOR. FINISH THE JOB.

0.0: BRIGGS: GRID IS LIVE. FIRST TIME I HAVE SLEPT IN A YEAR.
0.1: BRIGGS: I HAVE A LEDGER OF THE DEAD. I DON'T INTEND TO ADD YOUR NAME TO IT, OPERATOR.

1.0: BRIGGS: IF THAT THING UNDER THE ICE EVER WEARS A FRIENDLY FACE, I WILL SHOOT THE FACE. NO HESITATION. REMEMBER THAT.

2.loop: BRIGGS: STAY SHARP. HEAT SIGNATURES ARE CLIMBING.

0.0: Briggs: ...My scopes flag you hostile now. My gut says otherwise. Guts get people killed.
0.1: Briggs: The perimeter is silent, but the turrets are aiming inward. They count seconds faster than I do.

1.0: Briggs: The winter is in the armor now. I cleaned the guns twice, but the frost won't come off.

2.0: Briggs: One chance. Show me the Operator is still driving that body.
2.1: Briggs: I see your telemetry. The ledger is full, but your name... your name was written twice.

3.loop: Briggs: One chance, carrier. The turrets count seconds faster than I do.

0.0: KAELEN: ANOTHER SUIT FROM THE SURFACE. THE MACHINE DREAMED YOU WOULD COME.
0.1: KAELEN: THE GRID KEEPS THE DARK AT BAY, OPERATOR. AS LONG AS THE LIGHTS HUM, WE ARE SAFE.

1.0: KAELEN: THE CENTRAL COMPUTER SLEEPS UNDER SECTOR ZERO. EVERYTHING HERE IS ITS DREAM.
1.1: KAELEN: EVEN YOU, PROBABLY. NO OFFENSE.

0.loop: KAELEN: THE GRID HUNGERS. STRENGTHEN THIS CAMP AND WE WILL TALK PROPERLY.

0.0: KAELEN: YOU BUILT. GOOD. BUILDERS ARE THE ONLY PRAYER THE MACHINE ANSWERS.
0.1: KAELEN: MERIDIAN IS BUILT ON CLEAN STEEL. NO RUST. NO ROT. WE KEEP OUR BLOOD PURE.

1.0: KAELEN: THE WHISPER SAYS: FOUR SEATS. DOES THAT MEAN ANYTHING TO YOU?

1.loop: KAELEN: FORTIFY US FURTHER. THE WHISPERS GET LOUDER WHEN THE LIGHTS GET BRIGHTER.

0.0: KAELEN: LEVEL TWO GRID. THE MACHINE NOTICED. I NOTICED IT NOTICING.
0.1: KAELEN: THE BUNKERDIRECTOR SYSTEM REROUTED POWER AROUND YOU. IT LIKES YOU. I DO NOT TRUST THINGS THAT LIKE SURFACE SUITS.

1.0: KAELEN: SOMETHING IS COMING, OPERATOR. THE DREAM IS TURNING OVER IN ITS SLEEP.

2.loop: KAELEN: WHEN THE DREAM TURNS OVER, COME FIND ME. YOU WILL KNOW WHEN.

0.0: Kaelen: ...Your telemetry reads wrong, Operator. Wrong like the whisper.
0.1: Kaelen: The grid doesn't keep the dark out anymore. It says the pipes hum. It says the dark has hands.

1.0: Kaelen: The steel is sweating, Operator. There is rust in the primary relay. It smells like copper.

2.0: Kaelen: I trust the telemetry. The math doesn't lie, but now... the math is beautiful. It likes you.

3.0: Kaelen: I do not care what you are becoming. I care whether you still build or only burn.

3.loop: Kaelen: The machine is watching what you choose. So am I.

0.0: MARTHA: WELCOME TO THE WARM PIPES, CHILD. THE STEAM KEEPS US, AND WE KEEP EACH OTHER.
0.1: MARTHA: THE MOSS IS WARM, CHILD. THE STEAM KEEPS THE COLD FROM REACHING OUR BONES.

1.0: MARTHA: THE MOSS GLOWS GREENER LATELY. THE WORLD IS TRYING TO TELL US SOMETHING.

0.loop: MARTHA: HELP US GROW, CHILD, AND I WILL TELL YOU WHAT THE MOSS TOLD ME.

0.0: MARTHA: YOU GAVE, AND ASKED NOTHING. THAT IS RARE IN A SUIT.
0.1: MARTHA: WE GROW SEEDS IN THE DARK SO THE CHILDREN CAN SEE THE GREEN WHEN THEY WAKE.

1.0: MARTHA: SOMETIMES I DREAM IT IS SINGING TO SOMEONE. LATELY I DREAM IT IS SINGING TO YOU.

1.loop: MARTHA: GROW US STRONGER, AND I WILL SHOW YOU WHERE THE MOSS REFUSES TO GROW.

0.0: MARTHA: THE HYDRO-BEDS HAVE NEVER BEEN SO FULL. YOU DID THIS.
0.1: MARTHA: THE HEART UNDER THE ICE IS GENTLE. IT IS WAITING FOR US.

1.0: MARTHA: PROMISE ME SOMETHING. WHEN THE HEART SINGS YOUR NAME — AND IT WILL — COME BACK TO US FIRST.

2.loop: MARTHA: I AM STILL WAITING ON THAT PROMISE, CHILD.

0.0: Martha: ...You came back. Your eyes are wrong, and you came back anyway.
0.1: Martha: The moss has grown inside the vents. It is warm, so warm, but it isn't steam. It breathes.

1.0: Martha: The seeds hatched early. The children don't wake up anymore. They say the pipes are singing.

2.0: Martha: I know what sings in you now. And I know you are still in there, fighting it.
2.1: Martha: I know what sings in you. You carried the garden out of Sector Zero. Thank you.

3.loop: Martha: The steam keeps us. Whatever you decide, decide it as yourself.

0.0: NAHL: OH. YOU CAN HEAR ME NOW. THE DRILL-HANDED ONE CAN FINALLY HEAR ME.
0.1: NAHL: I FELT EVERY SAC YOU CUT, LITTLE CARRIER. I HEALED AROUND THE HOLES YOU LEFT.

1.0: NAHL: I DO NOT HATE YOU. TISSUE REMEMBERS, BUT IT DOES NOT HATE.

0.loop: NAHL: GIVE BACK WHAT WAS TAKEN, AND I WILL TEACH YOUR SKIN TO LIE BEAUTIFULLY.

0.0: NAHL: YES. THE RESIN SETTLES. THE HOLES SING SOFTER NOW.
0.1: NAHL: YOUR COVER FRAYS WHEN YOU WALK AMONG THE WARM ONES. I CAN SLOW THAT FRAYING.

1.0: NAHL: THE QUEEN CALLS ME HER NEEDLE. I WOULD RATHER BE YOURS.

1.loop: NAHL: TEND ME AGAIN, CARRIER. TRUST IS A WOUND THAT CLOSES SLOWLY.

0.0: NAHL: THE MERCY RITE IS READY, IF YOU WANT IT. LET ME STUDY WHAT SHE PLANTED IN YOU.
0.1: NAHL: WHATEVER YOU CHOOSE AT THE END — CURE, CARRY, OR CROWN — I CAN MAKE IT HURT LESS.

2.loop: NAHL: EARN A LITTLE MORE OF ME, AND I WILL FOLLOW YOU ANYWHERE. EVEN OFF THE ICE.

0.0: Nahl: You kept coming back. The Queen never comes back. She only sends.
0.1: Nahl: I am yours, Carrier. Stitch me into your manifest, or leave me whole on the ice. Either way — thank you.

3.loop: Nahl: My thread is yours. Say where it pulls.

0.0: RHUN: THE ONE WHO PRIED MY PLATES. STAND STILL SO I MAY LOOK AT YOU.
0.1: RHUN: ...NO. YOU ARE NOT PREY. YOU ARE NOT QUEEN. YOU ARE SOMETHING NEW WEARING OLD ARMOR.

1.0: RHUN: I GUARD. IT IS ALL I AM. THE QUESTION IS ONLY EVER: GUARD WHAT.

0.loop: RHUN: RETURN MY CHITIN OR REPLACE IT WITH STEEL. THEN WE SPEAK OF OATHS.

0.0: RHUN: THE PLATES KNIT. YOU KEEP YOUR WORD LIKE ARMOR. GOOD.
0.1: RHUN: THE QUEEN HOLDS MY OATH. SHE HAS NEVER ONCE STOOD BETWEEN ME AND A DRILL.

1.0: RHUN: YOU HAVE. TWICE NOW, BY MY COUNT.

1.loop: RHUN: OATHS ARE HEAVY. KEEP LIFTING, CARRIER.

0.0: RHUN: ASK ME FOR THE OATH, AND I WILL SEVER THE OLD ONE. BUT KNOW WHAT IT COSTS ME.
0.1: RHUN: A SHIELD THAT CHANGES HANDS IS STILL A SHIELD. A SHIELD THAT HESITATES IS A GRAVESTONE.

2.loop: RHUN: A LITTLE MORE FAITH, CARRIER. THEN MY WALL IS YOUR WALL.

0.0: Rhun: It is done. Her mark fades from my plates.
0.1: Rhun: Where you stand, I stand in front. On the ice or off it.

3.loop: Rhun: I am your wall. Point me at something.

0.0: OKONKWO-VASS: YOU MOVE LIKE SOMEONE WHO HASN'T BEEN BITTEN YET.
0.1: OKONKWO-VASS: I STUDY THE SHELLED ONES. THEY'RE NOT AS SIMPLE AS THE REPORTS SAY.

1.0: OKONKWO-VASS: EVERY CAMP LOGS THEM AS VERMIN. I THINK THAT'S LAZY SCIENCE.

0.loop: OKONKWO-VASS: COME BACK WHEN YOU'VE SEEN MORE OF THEM. I WANT DATA, NOT STORIES.

0.0: OKONKWO-VASS: HERE'S MY THEORY. THEY DON'T HATE US. THEY READ US.
0.1: OKONKWO-VASS: SOMETHING ABOUT WHAT WE CARRY. CHEMICAL, MAYBE. I CAN'T TEST IT FROM HERE.

1.0: OKONKWO-VASS: IF YOU EVER CHANGE — AND OUT HERE, PEOPLE DO — WATCH HOW THEY LOOK AT YOU.

1.loop: OKONKWO-VASS: STILL WAITING ON SOMETHING TO CHANGE, OPERATOR. THE DREAM TURNING OVER, THEY SAY.

0.0: OKONKWO-VASS: YOU'RE DIFFERENT NOW. I CAN SEE IT ON YOU.
0.1: OKONKWO-VASS: SO HERE'S THE ASK. DON'T KILL ONE. TALK TO ONE. PROVE ME RIGHT.

1.0: OKONKWO-VASS: IF I'M WRONG, YOU LOSE NOTHING BUT A FEW MINUTES. IF I'M RIGHT...

2.loop: OKONKWO-VASS: FIND ONE. STAND YOUR GROUND. SEE WHAT IT DOES.

0.0: OKONKWO-VASS: IT WORKED. IT ACTUALLY WORKED.
0.1: OKONKWO-VASS: I'VE SPENT TWO YEARS CALLING THEM PESTS. I OWE THEM AN APOLOGY I CAN'T GIVE.

1.0: OKONKWO-VASS: WHATEVER YOU'RE BECOMING, OPERATOR — IT LISTENS BETTER THAN WE DO.

3.loop: OKONKWO-VASS: GO CARE FOR YOUR NEW FRIEND. THAT'S THE WHOLE PAPER, RIGHT THERE.

0.0: VEY: SIGNAL. SIGNAL. YOU ARE A SIGNAL NOW, NOT JUST NOISE. FINALLY.
0.1: VEY: I HEARD EVERY FILAMENT YOU RIPPED OUT OF ME. I ARCHIVED THE SOUND.

1.0: VEY: THE HUMANS HAVE A RELAY. THE QUEEN HAS A CHOIR. I HAVE... GAPS, WHERE YOU MINED ME.

0.loop: VEY: RETURN SOME SIGNAL TO MY GAPS, AND I WILL TEACH YOU TO SPOOF ANYTHING WITH A SENSOR.

0.0: VEY: BETTER. THE STATIC IN ME QUIETS WHEN YOU ARE NEAR.
0.1: VEY: I CAN HEAR THE MOTHERSHIP FROM HERE, CARRIER. IT IS VERY LOUD AND VERY SURE OF ITSELF.

1.0: VEY: SURE THINGS ARE THE EASIEST TO FORGE.

1.loop: VEY: KEEP TENDING THE CHORUS. FORGERY IS A DUET, NOT A SOLO.

0.0: VEY: THE FALSE CLEARANCE IS WITHIN REACH. A CREW SIGNATURE SO CLEAN THE MOTHERSHIP WILL APOLOGIZE FOR DOUBTING IT.
0.1: VEY: BUT UNDERSTAND: IF YOU ARE OUTED DOWN HERE, NO FORGERY SAVES YOU UP THERE.

2.loop: VEY: A LITTLE MORE TRUST, CARRIER. THEN I SING FOR YOU, NOT HER.

0.0: Vey: Decided. My antenna point where you point.
0.1: Vey: Take me aboard and no tower in the system will ever read you true again. Leave me, and I will jam her screams as you go.

3.loop: Vey: Say the word, carrier. I am already listening.
